action: opened the order: Invent one new widget that goes beyond everything in the catalog. One remarkable idea, or none.
person at the terminal: proposed Unanswered (unanswered-widget), Later (later-widget), Pins (pins-widget)
Untapped capability: proposed Attic (attic-widget), Pocket (pocket-widget), Nudges (nudges-widget)
Delight: proposed Unsent (unsent-widget), Hands (hands-widget), Swear Jar (jar-widget)
took the order at ideation

stamped reject on "Pocket": The bridge prompt source covers a phone, a web client or a relay alike, so the widget cannot know the reader is on a phone, and its central moment cannot be proven without a live phone session.

stamped reject on "Nudges": It is witness-widget pointed at a second source of hidden context, the same verbatim tally with a size, and its one new act, muting engine reminders, removes guidance at a risk out of proportion to the tokens saved.

stamped reject on "Unanswered": In a coding session an ask is usually answered by an edit or a command, not by a quotable sentence, so the quote test would list done work as unanswered, and the no-model splitter misses asks in prose.
stamped reject on "Later": A variation on lessons-widget's catching of phrases from prompts joined to stakes-widget's line under the dialog, holding what notes-widget and parking-widget already hold.

stamped reject on "Pins": A variation on situation-widget and playbook-widget, telling Claude a fact about the environment, and it measures a different shell from the one Claude's Bash tool runs, so its table can be wrong in the very case it exists for.

stamped reject on "Unsent": A novelty that is funny once: it keeps text the person chose to delete, and the longest-draft comparison cannot tell a change of mind from ordinary editing or a trimmed paste.
stamped reject on "Hands": A variation on theseus-widget, which already accounts for the lines Claude replaced from git history; adding authors and ages is a new column, not a new widget.
stamped reject on "Swear Jar": A phrase counter with a picture, in the family of mirror-widget and badges-widget, that changes nothing and tells the person nothing they do not already know.
named the widget attic-widget ("Attic")

stamped pass: Attic is the only idea that does something no shipped or waiting widget can: it moves tool schemas in and out of every request from counted evidence, corrects itself, and reports a measured saving, with every call it needs present in the types file.
